preserved_boundaries.transformation_quantitation: no formation fractions, rate constants, DT50 values or concentrations inferred from predicted pathways

preserved_boundaries.reach: EnviroChem review bundles remain distinct from IUCLID i6z dossiers
preserved_boundaries.us_epa_tools: ChemSTEER, CEM, E-FAST and PWC remain external, versioned workflows; no EPA executable is bundled, modified or represented as native output
preserved_boundaries.draft_scenarios: only 12 published ESDs are enabled by default; 48 draft/reference records require explicit selection and remain labelled
